limitations: Static declarations only; no Spring/Nacos precedence or effective route merge is computed.
Profile filenames and on-profile expressions are labels, not evaluated activation.
Route lists replace rather than merge elements; default filters are recorded separately.
No host environment, real .env, env_file, systemd EnvironmentFile or remote Nacos contents are read.
Compose candidates retain service scope; declarations do not prove container injection or reachability.
Shell references/exports and image ENV are candidates only; shell control flow and image stages are not evaluated.
Non-Path predicates and non-allowlisted filter arguments are redacted; dynamic routes and relaxed binding are not resolved.
Hashes identify complete source files; line locations identify declaration nodes, including anchor definitions.
